scope: Callable tools exposed through this Codex session's ALL_TOOLS registry; UI/orchestration wrappers are additional surfaces, not included in this count.
target: Track a verified LocalBot equivalent or an authenticated integration for every entry. Unimplemented and unavailable entries are not completion.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.route: apply_patch supports multi-file Add/Update/Delete, Move to, exact @@ hunks and End of File; all existing sources require read_file SHA-256, every patch requires approval, recovery preimages retained. Strict unique matching; not the full fuzzy Codex parser or crash-atomic filesystem transactions.

tools.name: clock__curr_time
tools.route: current_time reads the runtime system clock and returns ISO UTC, Unix milliseconds, IANA zone local time and UTC offset; defaults to UTC.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.route: Persistent conversation-scoped goals with active/blocked/complete state and evidence; no token budgeting, usage accounting or autonomous scheduling yet.

tools.name: exec_command
tools.route: Sandboxed process_start/process_poll/process_input/process_stop with task/agent/workspace ownership, bounded output, stdin, five-minute lifetime and cleanup. No PTY, persistent detached jobs or network access. process_poll supports cancellable output/exit waits up to 60 seconds (10 seconds by default), with 0 for immediate snapshots.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.route: Persistent conversation-scoped goals with active/blocked/complete state and evidence; no token budgeting, usage accounting or autonomous scheduling yet.

tools.name: image_gen__imagegen
tools.route: No image-generation adapter exists. Requires a user-selected supported image provider and authorized account; the Codex decision bridge does not imply image-generation access.

tools.name: list_mcp_resource_templates
tools.route: mcp_list_resource_templates: enabled connection and explicit cursor pagination.

tools.name: list_mcp_resources
tools.route: mcp_list_resources: enabled connection, explicit cursor pagination, bounded result validation.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__automation_update
tools.route: Needs LocalBot-owned persistent schedules, timezone/recurrence validation, missed-run policy, idempotent enqueue and quiet notification policy. No scheduler added and no broad autonomous goal loop.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__capture_screen_context
tools.route: Needs native screen capture/accessibility grants, foreground-target selection and user-visible capture policy. Outside this runtime-only branch; no access to Codex voice capture.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__consume_usage_reset
tools.route: No reset action implemented. Requires an officially supported account mutation, fresh eligibility, explicit one-credit authorization and idempotency; never simulated through read-only usage.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__create_sidebar_section
tools.route: Needs a LocalBot section table and native/sidebar integration; not supported by runtime tools.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__create_thread
tools.route: Existing authenticated local HTTP conversation creation is user-facing. An agent counterpart needs explicit-request authorization, project/workspace scope and idempotent enqueue; not exposed as an agent tool.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__delete_sidebar_section
tools.route: Needs LocalBot section storage plus non-destructive reassignment and native UI integration; no section records currently managed.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__end_realtime_voice_call
tools.route: LocalBot has no owned real-time voice call; needs a voice provider/session lifecycle and explicit end-call request.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__fork_thread
tools.route: Needs durable lineage and a transactional snapshot of completed source history plus workspace/branch conflict rules; no copy of Codex host state.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__get_handoff_status
tools.route: Needs a LocalBot-owned handoff operation record, bounded status wait and revision cursors; no host migration operation currently exists.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__get_usage_limits
tools.route: get_usage_limits reads official Codex CLI account/rateLimits/read after ChatGPT authentication, with Web permission, bounded deadline, cancellation, response validation and error redaction. Returns account-wide primary/secondary and per-limit windows; omits credit balance/reset-credit details and remote-host selection.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__handoff_thread
tools.route: Needs safe workspace transfer or owned worktree creation, clean-state/conflict handling, cancellation and durable operation state. No changes to user workspaces implemented here.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__list_archived_threads
tools.route: list_conversations with state archived: scoped metadata pagination; no cross-project desktop access.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__list_projects
tools.route: Authenticated local snapshot contains user projects; a model-facing cross-project list needs explicit access policy. Current conversation/project context is already supplied to the engine.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__list_threads
tools.route: list_conversations: bounded ten-record pages of current metadata scoped to the calling conversation or its project; archive filters and owned cursors. Global cross-project desktop visibility is intentionally unavailable.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__load_workspace_dependencies
tools.route: Needs explicit configured local runtimes and capability probes; shell tools may inspect approved workspace dependencies, but Codex bundled runtime paths are not portable.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__move_project_to_sidebar_section
tools.route: Needs LocalBot section schema, project access policy, validated membership and native client support.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__move_thread_to_sidebar_section
tools.route: Needs LocalBot section schema and scoped conversation ordering with native client support.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__navigate_to_codex_page
tools.route: Needs a LocalBot runtime-to-native navigation command with ownership validation and acknowledgement; no native files changed in this branch.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__open_in_codex
tools.route: Existing artifacts can be opened by the user. An agent-controlled native file/browser/terminal panel requires a typed UI command bridge and path/URL validation.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__read_thread
tools.route: read_history and list_tasks: bounded task-relative messages/status within current conversation or project; no arbitrary cross-project access or remote host access.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__read_thread_terminal
tools.route: read_activity returns persisted owned tool output; process_poll reads live task/agent-owned command output. No arbitrary native terminal buffer access.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__rename_sidebar_section
tools.route: Needs LocalBot section storage, expected-state conflict detection and native sidebar integration.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__reorder_section
tools.route: Needs validated complete membership permutation, transaction and native UI integration for LocalBot sections.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__reorder_sidebar_projects
tools.route: Needs durable project ordering, validated IDs and native UI integration.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__reorder_sidebar_sections
tools.route: Needs durable section ordering and exact membership validation; no sections schema yet.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__send_message_to_thread
tools.route: Existing user HTTP message endpoint uses retry-safe request IDs. Agent-to-conversation dispatch needs explicit messaging authorization, scoped recipient selection, idempotency and resource scheduling; not exposed.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__set_thread_archived
tools.route: Store and authenticated HTTP support reversible archival and reject active conversations. Agent counterpart still requires scoped target selection and explicit approval; current task cannot archive its own running conversation.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__set_thread_title
tools.route: rename_conversation: current conversation only; Ask-mode approval, exact expected_title conflict detection, bounded title, cancellation and durable metadata. Renaming another conversation is intentionally unavailable.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__share_thread
tools.route: Needs explicit export/publication approval, immutable sanitized snapshot, revocable sharing service and private-data policy. Local artifacts are not public share URLs.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__uninstall_plugin
tools.route: Needs LocalBot-owned plugin manifest/install registry, dependency checks and reviewable removal; must not uninstall Codex plugins.

tools.name: mcp__codex_app__wait_threads
tools.route: list_tasks reports current/earlier scoped states; cancellable task-state subscriptions with revision cursors and bounded multi-target waits remain unimplemented.

tools.name: mcp__node_repl__js
tools.route: Sandboxed terminal supports nonpersistent Node scripts; a persistent Node REPL with isolated state, output/image limits, cancellation and cleanup remains unimplemented.

tools.name: mcp__node_repl__js_add_node_module_dir
tools.route: Requires a sandboxed persistent Node session with validated workspace-only module directories; no arbitrary host module path grants.

tools.name: mcp__node_repl__js_reset
tools.route: Requires persistent Node sessions; existing task-owned shell process_stop is not REPL state reset.

tools.name: mcp__openai_artifact_template_picker__choose_artifact_template
tools.route: Requires a LocalBot template catalog and explicit choice workflow, workspace-safe copied resources and provenance; Codex personal template host APIs are unavailable.

tools.name: mcp__openai_artifact_template_picker__list_artifact_templates
tools.route: Requires a configured LocalBot template directory/catalog with safe discovery and metadata validation.

tools.name: read_mcp_resource
tools.route: mcp_read_resource: per-read approval and integration permission checks; server-mediated URI reads, validated bounded text/base64 contents.

tools.name: request_plugin_install
tools.route: Requires a LocalBot plugin manifest, trusted install sources, reviewable permissions, version pinning, install rollback and explicit user installation action.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.route: Persistent conversation-scoped goals with active/blocked/complete state and evidence; no token budgeting, usage accounting or autonomous scheduling yet.

tools.name: view_image
tools.route: view_image reads validated workspace pictures with filesystem permission, retains an artifact and passes multimodal input through Codex CLI or opt-in Ollama/OpenAI-compatible providers. Codex live verified; HTTP protocol verified; actual local vision inference and resolution controls remain unverified/unimplemented.

tools.name: web__run
tools.route: web_fetch provides bounded public HTTPS retrieval with validated redirects. web_search uses an explicitly selected Codex CLI subscription provider, Web permission and verified native search events with source links. No local-provider cloud fallback. Interactive browser, finance, weather and other web categories remain incomplete.

tools.name: write_stdin
tools.route: Sandboxed process_start/process_poll/process_input/process_stop with task/agent/workspace ownership, bounded output, stdin, five-minute lifetime and cleanup. No PTY, persistent detached jobs or network access. process_poll supports cancellable output/exit waits up to 60 seconds (10 seconds by default), with 0 for immediate snapshots.

controlTools.name: functions.exec
controlTools.route: LocalBot engine dispatches audited tool calls sequentially; process_start/terminal execute sandboxed commands. No arbitrary privileged JavaScript orchestration runtime.

controlTools.name: functions.wait
controlTools.route: process_poll supports cancellable bounded waits for owned process sessions. No persisted JavaScript execution cells.

controlTools.name: functions.request_user_input
controlTools.route: ask_user persists a question and stops in awaiting_input; next user message continues context. No Plan-mode multi-choice form.

controlTools.name: functions.request_user_input_async
controlTools.route: ask_user suspends work; an asynchronous question queue with multiple-choice answers and task wakeups is not implemented.

controlTools.name: clock.sleep
controlTools.route: No general agent sleep capability; process_poll waits for process activity only. A future delay must share task cancellation and runtime limits.

controlTools.name: collaboration.followup_task
controlTools.route: Needs owned child-run records, explicit dispatch authorization and idempotent follow-up delivery; existing sequential project routing is not child-agent orchestration.

controlTools.name: collaboration.interrupt_agent
controlTools.route: Runtime cancellation stops a whole task and owned process sessions; individual delegated-agent interruption is not available as an agent tool.

controlTools.name: collaboration.list_agents
controlTools.route: list_agents returns configured contacts with pagination and current-conversation membership, not live delegated child-agent trees.

controlTools.name: collaboration.send_message
controlTools.route: Needs task-owned child-agent mailboxes, bounded queued messages, delivery receipts and cancellation handling.

controlTools.name: collaboration.spawn_agent
controlTools.route: Needs task-owned child agents and shared-workspace scheduling. Existing project team routing runs configured contacts sequentially, not arbitrary subagents.

controlTools.name: collaboration.wait_agent
controlTools.route: Needs cancellable mailbox/state notifications for delegated children; list_tasks offers recorded states only.

controlTools.name: mcp__cua_repl.js
controlTools.route: Needs an explicitly configured browser/native automation adapter with platform permissions, target ownership, screenshots and cancellation; no reuse of Codex session UI tools.

controlTools.name: mcp__cua_repl.js_reset
controlTools.route: Depends on a LocalBot-owned computer-use session lifecycle; no such session exists yet.
